basic_details.job_title: CSIR-CDRI Research Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-Central Drug Research Institute (CSIR-CDRI), Lucknow, has invited online applications under Advertisement No. 12/2026 (dated 06.11.2026) for 8 Research Intern positions in the "CSIR-CDRI Research Internship Program" (project code CLP09007). The stipend is Rs. 12500/- p.m. consolidated, the tenure runs up to 31.03.2027, and the essential qualification is a Master Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Sciences, Medicinal Chemistry or Pharmaceutical Chemistry completed in 2025-2026. The upper age limit is 28 years, and the last date of online application is 12.11.2026.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and by 3 years for OBC candidates, or as per Government of India instructions issued from time to time. Candidates seeking relaxation must enclose the relevant certificate, in the prescribed format, issued by the appropriate authority. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

how_to_apply: Applications for Position Code 001 are to be submitted online on or before 12.11.2026. The notice does not print the web address of the application portal or step-by-step form instructions, but it says what the application must contain.
Mention in the application all qualifications and experience in the relevant area over and above the minimum prescribed qualification.
Attach the supporting documents for those qualifications and experience.
If the final certificates show CGPA/SGPA/OGPA grades, convert the grade to an equivalent percentage using the University's approved formula in the online form, and attach a copy of the conversion.
Candidates seeking age relaxation enclose the relevant certificate in the prescribed format.
Supporting documents for qualifications and experience
Copy of the grade-to-percentage conversion, where the final certificates show grades
Age relaxation certificate, where relaxation is sought

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CDRI Research Intern at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: CSIR-Central Drug Research Institute, Lucknow, is described in the notice as a premier institute functioning under the aegis of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR). CSIR is an autonomous body under the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India. The notice calls this an engagement of Research Interns, held online for the interview stage.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 28 years, reckoned as on the last date of submission of application. The notice requires essential qualifications to be held as on that last date. The upper age limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and by 3 years for OBC candidates, or as per Government of India instructions issued from time to time. Candidates seeking relaxation must enclose the relevant certificate, in the prescribed format, issued by the appropriate authority. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Master Degree in Chemistry / Chemical Sciences / Medicinal Chemistry / Pharmaceutical Chemistry; master's degree completed in the year 2025-2026
rows.desirable: GATE/NET-LS/DST-INSPIRE/GPAT or equivalent; good knowledge of Organic Chemistry

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-CDRI Research Intern
content_sections.text: Applications for Position Code 001 are to be submitted online on or before 12.11.2026. The notice does not print the web address of the application portal or step-by-step form instructions, but it says what the application must contain. Mention in the application all qualifications and experience in the relevant area over and above the minimum prescribed qualification. Attach the supporting documents for those qualifications and experience. If the final certificates show CGPA/SGPA/OGPA grades, convert the grade to an equivalent percentage using the University's approved formula in the online form, and attach a copy of the conversion. Candidates seeking age relaxation enclose the relevant certificate in the prescribed format. Supporting documents for qualifications and experience Copy of the grade-to-percentage conversion, where the final certificates show grades Age relaxation certificate, where relaxation is sought

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice describes shortlisting by a Screening Committee followed by an online interview. If a large number of candidates apply, the Screening Committee may add screening criteria beyond the essential and desirable qualifications and shortlist candidates for interview in proportion to the available vacancies. The prescribed essential qualifications are the minimum. Holding them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview, as the Screening Committee will adopt its own criteria. The list of shortlisted candidates will be notified on the CDRI website. The date of interview will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through e-mail. The interview date is not specified in the notice. On selection, the original documents, including eligibility qualification, date of birth, caste and age relaxation certificate, will be verified. If any discrepancy is found, the selection stands cancelled automatically.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Intern vacancies has CSIR-CDRI announced?
faq.answer: CSIR-CDRI has announced 8 Research Intern positions under Position Code 001 of Advertisement No. 12/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-CDRI Research Intern?
faq.answer: The last date of online application is 12.11.2026. Applications submitted after the scheduled date and time will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CSIR-CDRI Research Intern?
faq.answer: A Master Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Sciences, Medicinal Chemistry or Pharmaceutical Chemistry, completed in the year 2025-2026. GATE/NET-LS/DST-INSPIRE/GPAT or equivalent and good knowledge of Organic Chemistry are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSIR-CDRI Research Intern?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years, counted as on the last date of submission of application.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets age relaxation?
faq.answer: SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates get 5 years and OBC candidates get 3 years, or as per Government of India instructions. A relevant certificate in the prescribed format must be enclosed.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for CSIR-CDRI Research Intern?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 12500/- p.m. consolidated.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: A Screening Committee shortlists candidates, and shortlisted candidates are called for an online interview. The interview date will be sent by e-mail, and the shortlist will be notified on the CDRI website.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No regular post is offered. The tenure of the project runs up to 31.03.2027, and the engagement does not confer any right to regularisation against any CSIR/CDRI post.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA or allowances will be paid to candidates for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Does holding the minimum qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The essential qualifications are only the minimum, and the Screening Committee will use its own criteria for shortlisting candidates.
